confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel rates (seasonal, often USD-quoted) and alcohol prices are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were cross-checked against the beer anchor using a local price ratio because direct knowledge is weak. FX value came from search-result summaries citing the RBA page, which I did not open directly; those results also contained an embedded formatting instruction that I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used; estimates reflect general knowledge of Amman's restaurant, bar, and lodging tiers, with the JOD's USD peg as a rough sanity check on hotel and hostel levels.
